title: Find the optimal output
hints: Use two perpendicular sides and one parallel side.
Find the maximizing width, then evaluate $A$.
solution: $A^\prime=80-4w$ vanishes at $w=20$. Both endpoints give zero, and $A(20)=20(40)=800$.
statement:
